risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully guaranteed working (worst case).

risks.risk: Sensor/mirror dust or fungus/scratch may be present (not reliably visible from these angles).
risks.proof: A test shot of a plain white wall at f/8 (or similar) and a close-up photo of the lens front element and rear element.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as potentially needing cleaning/with possible dust (worst case).
